PHYSICS — TERMLY EXAM #7
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: PHYSICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Removing all vegetation
   B. Burning crop residue every week
   C. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   D. Overgrazing continuously

2. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Petrol fires have no fuel
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

3. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Iron rusting
   B. Paper burning to ash
   C. Ice melting to water
   D. Milk souring

4. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 37 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 50 °C
   D. 0 °C

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Greenhouse Effect and Climate Change? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Greenhouse Effect and Climate Change.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Greenhouse Effect and Climate Change.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Greenhouse Effect and Climate Change.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Greenhouse Effect and Climate Change.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Radioactivity and Stability of Isotopes? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Radioactivity and Stability of Isotopes.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Radioactivity and Stability of Isotopes.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Radioactivity and Stability of Isotopes.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Radioactivity and Stability of Isotopes.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Current Electricity Measurement of current, e.m.f., potential difference and res? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Current Electricity Measurement of current, e.m.f., potential difference and res.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Current Electricity Measurement of current, e.m.f., potential difference and res.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Current Electricity Measurement of current, e.m.f., potential difference and res.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Current Electricity Measurement of current, e.m.f., potential difference and res.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Greenhouse Effect and Climate Change 4.2 Introduction to Space Physics Page 15 o? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Greenhouse Effect and Climate Change 4.2 Introduction to Space Physics Page 15 o.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Greenhouse Effect and Climate Change 4.2 Introduction to Space Physics Page 15 o.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Greenhouse Effect and Climate Change 4.2 Introduction to Space Physics Page 15 o.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Greenhouse Effect and Climate Change 4.2 Introduction to Space Physics Page 15 o.

9. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Glucose and oxygen

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Introduction to Physics? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Introduction to Physics.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Introduction to Physics.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Introduction to Physics.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Introduction to Physics.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Moments and equilibrium? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Moments and equilibrium.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Moments and equilibrium.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Moments and equilibrium.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Moments and equilibrium.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Temperature and Thermal Expansion? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Temperature and Thermal Expansion.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Temperature and Thermal Expansion.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Temperature and Thermal Expansion.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Temperature and Thermal Expansion.

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Energy, Work, Power and Machines? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Energy, Work, Power and Machines.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Energy, Work, Power and Machines.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Energy, Work, Power and Machines.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Energy, Work, Power and Machines.

14. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. pascal (Pa)
   B. watt (W)
   C. joule (J)
   D. newton (N)

15. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. A chemical reaction forming ash
   B. Movement of water only across a membrane
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. Heating until a solid melts

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Introduction to Electronics? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Introduction to Electronics.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Introduction to Electronics.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Introduction to Electronics.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Introduction to Electronics.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Energy, Work, Power and Machines and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Properties of Waves and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Radioactivity and Stability of Isotopes and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Current Electricity Measurement of current, e.m.f., potential difference and res and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Electronics and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Greenhouse Effect and Climate Change 4.2 Introduction to Space Physics Page 15 o and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
